name: Westwood Robotics THEMIS TH02 Gen2.5
summary: A full-size (1.6 m, 36.5 kg) bipedal general-purpose humanoid with 42 DoF, 7-DoF three-finger hands, force-controlled BEAR actuators and hot-swap batteries. It is sold to order as a research and development platform.

germany.statusNote: Westwood Robotics (Los Angeles) takes orders through its own contact form and online store. No German or EU distributor was found; the maker's FAQ says customers outside the US ship units to its location in China for repairs.

specs.label: Degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: 6 per leg, 7 per arm, 7 per hand, 2 head
specs.quote: 42 Total DoF 6 DoF Leg x2 7 DoF Arm x2 7 DoF Hand x2 2 DoF Head

specs.label: Payload capacity
specs.conditions: maximum payload the robot can carry; dynamic model may need adjusting
specs.quote: Payload Capacity is the maximum payload the robot can carry; appropriate adjustments to the robot's dynamic model may be required to achieve stable performance.

specs.label: Max endurance
specs.conditions: 120 min walking on flat ground without payload; up to 180 min with the extended-range battery
specs.quote: Endurance: Up to 120 minutes of continuous operation.

specs.label: Battery
specs.quote: Battery System: Dual 259.2 Wh Li-Ion packs supporting hot-swapping for non-stop operation.

specs.label: Compute
specs.conditions: AMD Ryzen 7840HS main control; Jetson Orin NX 16GB vision computers
specs.quote: Dual Computing Units: Up to 314 TOPS (Combined) for vision, manipulation planning, ground depth mapping, and foot placement.

specs.label: Hands
specs.conditions: two hands in the standard configuration
specs.quote: 7-DoF Adaptive Hands: Three-finger hands with force control and configurable grasping.

capabilities.sdk: Maker OS controlled through LLMs, pseudo-code and AI-assisted teleoperation (brochure)
notes: Optional liquid cooling for hip and knee actuators for continuous high-load operation.
Endurance and speed are measured on flat ground without payload.
